   3	## 1. Project Overview
   4	Create a lightweight, frontend-only demo website for Managing General Agents (MGAs) to quickly create Commercial Property and Commercial General Liability (CGL) insurance quotes.
   5	
   6	**Purpose**: This is a simple test/demo site ONLY. It exists to validate functionality of a separate browser extension that will read the active account/submission from the DMS and auto-fill carrier quoting/rating pages. Keep effort minimal.
   7	
   8	## 2. Scope & Constraints (Strict MVP)
   9	- 100% client-side (Vite + React + TypeScript)
  10	- No backend, no API, no database, no authentication, no security
  11	- All data stored in localStorage only
  12	- Hardcoded rates and simple calculations
  13	- Three pages only: Login, Dashboard, Create/Edit Quote
  14	
  15	## 3. Tech Stack
  16	- Vite + React 18 + TypeScript
  17	- Tailwind CSS (for clean, professional UI)
  18	- jsPDF (or equivalent) for PDF generation
  19	- React Router for navigation
  20	- Simple state (useState + localStorage; no heavy libraries needed)
  21	
  22	## 4. Pages & Features
  23	
  24	### Login Page (`/login`)
  25	- Simple demo form (email + password)
  26	- Accept ANY email with password `demo123`
  27	- "Login" button navigates straight to Dashboard
  28	
  29	### Dashboard (`/`)
  30	- Header with placeholder logo/title
  31	- Prominent "New Quote" button
  32	- Table of saved quotes (loaded from localStorage)
  33	  - Columns: Quote ID, Type (Property/GL/Package), Insured Name, Total Premium, Created Date
  34	- Click any row to edit that quote
  35	
  36	### Create/Edit Quote Page
  37	- Top selector/tabs:
  38	  - Property Only
  39	  - GL Only
  40	  - Package (Property + GL)
  41	- Form fields (grouped cleanly):
  42	  - Insured Details (name, address, city, state, ZIP)
  43	  - Location / Building Info
  44	  - Building Values
  45	  - Liability Limits
  46	  - Prior Claims
  47	  - Coverage Options (basic checkboxes)
  48	- Real-time preview panel (right side or bottom) showing premium breakdown + total
  49	- Buttons:
  50	  - Save Draft (to localStorage)
  51	  - Generate & Download PDF Quote
  52	  - Cancel / Back to Dashboard

  56	- Recalculate and update preview live on every form change
